matrix.data_fields: Fiscal year; company; account; analytic plans (business unit, project, phase, cost center, expense type); budget version; currency
matrix.handoff: Accounting › Analytic plans → Budgets; templates out to Spreadsheet
matrix.exceptions: New project mid-year needs lines; COA changes after load; intercompany charges across PHI entities

matrix.data_fields: Department; account; monthly amounts; justification; prior-year actual; version; approver; approval date
matrix.handoff: Spreadsheet import → Budget (draft) → Approvals → Budget (confirmed) → budget check on PR/PO/bill
matrix.exceptions: Realignment between lines; supplemental budget; rejected versions kept for audit; approved over-budget override

matrix.trigger_event: Project approved on feasibility, or new phase launched
matrix.data_fields: Project; phase; cost code; categories (land, planning, permits, titling, construction by milestone, marketing, sales, loan interest); contingency %; revenue forecast (units × price)
matrix.handoff: Project Development → Budget on project analytic → Project WBS; baseline snapshot kept for variance
matrix.exceptions: Budgets spanning several fiscal years; re-baseline after scope change; price escalation; overrun beyond contingency

matrix.trigger_event: Loan agreement signed; approved funding requirement
matrix.data_fields: Lender; facility; principal; fixed/floating rate; tenor; drawdown date; amortization schedule; collateral; project allocation; capitalize-interest flag
matrix.handoff: Treasury → Accounting (loan liability, interest accrual) → project analytic (capitalized interest) → AP (debt-service schedule)
matrix.exceptions: Repricing; prepayment penalties; stop capitalizing interest at completion; covenant breach

matrix.data_fields: Requester; cost center; category (branding, admin, departmental, executive); amount; budget line; vendor; attachments
matrix.handoff: Purchase request / Approvals → budget check → PO → vendor bill (16)
matrix.exceptions: Unbudgeted urgent spend; recurring contracts (utilities, subscriptions); petty cash and reimbursements via Expenses

matrix.data_fields: Owner(s); location; OCT/TCT no.; lot area; tax declaration no.; zoning; encumbrances; appraised value; asking price; broker
matrix.handoff: Custom land register + Documents workspace → Approvals to ManCom
matrix.exceptions: Title defects or adverse claims; multiple heirs (extrajudicial settlement); CARP/DAR coverage; informal settlers

matrix.data_fields: Agreement type (deed of sale, CTS, JV); price; milestones (condition, date, %); taxes borne by; JV sharing ratio
matrix.handoff: Sign → vendor bill per milestone → AP (16) → Accounting (land held for development / advances)
matrix.exceptions: JV landowner paid in units (non-cash, inventory allocation); unmet milestone conditions; renegotiation; installment interest

matrix.data_fields: CGT; DST; transfer tax; registration fees; eCAR no.; new TCT no.; dates
matrix.handoff: Fees → AP; TCT no. → land register and project master; land cost capitalized to project analytic
matrix.exceptions: Who shoulders taxes; late-filing surcharges; consolidation or subdivision of titles before development

matrix.trigger_event: Land titled and project budget approved
matrix.data_fields: Project code; name; company; location; type (horizontal / vertical); phases; blocks or towers; WBS; analytic account; permits (DP, ECC, BP, CR/LTS)
matrix.handoff: Project ↔ analytic account ↔ Budget; permit tracker; releases to unit creation (07.1)
matrix.exceptions: Project across entities or JV; phasing changes; no LTS means no selling — system must block reservations

matrix.data_fields: Contractor; contract amount; BOQ / cost code; downpayment %; retention %; progress %; cumulative billed; recoupment; variation orders; EWT
matrix.handoff: Purchase (contract/PO) → Project milestone % → vendor bill with retention and recoupment → AP; % completion → unit construction status and POC revenue
matrix.exceptions: Variation orders; liquidated damages; back-charges; retention release after defects liability period; owner-furnished materials

matrix.data_fields: Lot ID (project-phase-block-lot; tower-floor-unit for condos); house model; lot and floor area; list price / TCP; price per sqm; VAT treatment; parking; construction status; sales status; mother / derivative title
matrix.handoff: Lot master (vendor-proposed) ↔ product and pricelist ↔ project analytic; availability board to CRM and brokers; every downstream document (reservation, CTS, ledger, turnover, title) references the Lot
matrix.exceptions: Condo units, parking slots and house-and-lot packages modeled as lots; lot merge or split; price increases on unsold lots only; management / model-unit holds; VAT threshold treatment

matrix.trigger_event: New price list or promo scheme
matrix.data_fields: Scheme (spot cash, deferred cash, bank, Pag-IBIG, IHF); reservation fee; DP % and months; discount %; interest rate; loanable %; term; validity
matrix.handoff: Payment-term templates → sales computation (09.1) → amortization engine (11)
matrix.exceptions: Promo expiry; scheme change after reservation (restructuring); Pag-IBIG loan ceilings

matrix.data_fields: Firm and agent names; PRC license no. and expiry; DHSUD registration; TIN and COR 2303; bank details; commission tier; parent firm; validity
matrix.handoff: Contacts (partner tags) → Documents → Approvals → commission plan; selectable on CRM / sales order
matrix.exceptions: Expired license must block tagging; agent changing firms mid-deal; split commission between firms

matrix.data_fields: Buyer name, TIN, IDs, civil status; co-borrower; unit; TCP; discounts; VAT; other charges; reservation fee; DP schedule; balance; scheme; broker / agent; promo code
matrix.handoff: CRM opportunity → sales quotation (computation) → invoice / receipt for reservation fee → unit status reserved
matrix.exceptions: Double reservation of one unit (lock needed); bounced RF check; reservation expiry and RF forfeiture; discount above authority; OFW buyers with SPA

matrix.trigger_event: Documents complete and DP policy met
matrix.data_fields: CTS no.; parties; unit; TCP; payment schedule (due dates, principal / interest split); penalty clause; Maceda clause; signatories; notarization date
matrix.handoff: Sales order confirmed → Sign → Documents → buyer ledger and amortization schedule (11)
matrix.exceptions: Amendments: transfer of rights, unit swap, restructuring; co-owner change; death of buyer

matrix.trigger_event: CTS signed and collectability threshold met (per policy)
matrix.data_fields: % completion; collections %; cost-to-complete; significant financing component
matrix.handoff: Periodic journal in Accounting driven by project % complete (06.1) and collections (11.2)
matrix.exceptions: PFRS 15 over-time recognition assumptions; reversal on cancellation; auditor-agreed thresholds

matrix.data_fields: Tenant; unit; lease rate; escalation %; term; start / end; security deposit; advance rent; CUSA; utilities; PDCs; VAT / EWT
matrix.handoff: Unit status leased → Rental or Subscription → recurring invoices → AR
matrix.exceptions: Pre-termination; holdover; rent-free periods; applying deposit against damages

matrix.data_fields: Checklist per scheme; document status; received date; expiry (IDs); file
matrix.handoff: Documents workspace linked to buyer and unit; completeness gate for CTS (09.2) and takeout (13.1)
matrix.exceptions: Expired documents; consularized documents from abroad

matrix.data_fields: Payor; amount; mode (cash, check, PDC, transfer, online); check no., bank, date; allocation (RF, DP, amortization, penalty, other charges); invoice series; VAT breakdown
matrix.handoff: Accounting payment → allocation on buyer ledger; BIR-registered invoice series (CAS / e-invoicing)
matrix.exceptions: PDC warehousing; bounced checks; partial or over-payment; unidentified deposits; EOPT invoice-vs-receipt rules

matrix.trigger_event: Monthly cycle (timer) or due date lapsed
matrix.data_fields: Amount due; paid; balance; days past due; penalty rate and amount; aging bucket
matrix.handoff: Follow-up reports → demand letters → collection dashboard → cancellation trigger (12.1)
matrix.exceptions: Penalty waivers (approval); restructuring; grace periods under RA 6552

matrix.trigger_event: Buyer request, or default beyond grace
matrix.data_fields: Reason code; total paid; years of installments; cash surrender value (50% + 5%/yr after 5 yrs, max 90%); deductions; notarial notice date; effective date; approval
matrix.handoff: Accounting reversal (AR, revenue, commission clawback) → AP refund (16) → unit status available
matrix.exceptions: Under 2 years paid (no CSV, 60-day grace); disputes; refunds in installments; unit already turned over

matrix.data_fields: Lender; loan amount; loanable %; requirements checklist; application date; LOG / NOA no. and date; release date; proceeds; deductions (fees, MRI); DOAS
matrix.handoff: Takeout tracker → Titling (annotation) → Accounting (proceeds applied) → buyer balance closed
matrix.exceptions: Disapproval or partial approval (buyer pays gap); Pag-IBIG buyback guarantee; LOG expiry

matrix.data_fields: Principal; rate; term; amortization method; due day; collateral
matrix.handoff: Amortization schedule → monthly SOA (11.3) → interest income
matrix.exceptions: Repricing; early payoff; later refinancing to a bank

matrix.step: TORC (taxes and other related charges) processing
matrix.trigger_event: Full payment reached / title transfer started
matrix.data_fields: DST; transfer tax; registration fees; other fees; budget line; payee agency; liquidation; amount rechargeable to buyer
matrix.handoff: Titling → cash advance or bill → AP (16) → Accounting (buyer charge or project cost)
matrix.exceptions: Zonal-value updates; unliquidated advances; surcharges

matrix.data_fields: Unit; inspection date; punch-list items; rectification status; acceptance date; keys; meter readings; warranty end date
matrix.handoff: Field Service / Project tasks → Sign (acceptance) → unit status turned over → PM onboarding and dues (18.1)
matrix.exceptions: Buyer no-show (deemed acceptance clause); major defects; turnover before full payment by exception

matrix.data_fields: Vendor; TIN; bill no. and date; PO ref; receipt / accomplishment ref; VAT; EWT ATC code; retention; due date; analytic distribution; approver
matrix.handoff: Purchase ↔ bill (3-way match) → Approvals → payment batch → bank → BIR 2307 → budget actuals
matrix.exceptions: Bills without PO; duplicates; partial payment; supplier advances; foreign currency

matrix.data_fields: Payment method; bank; check no.; release date; 2307
matrix.handoff: Accounting → bank file or check printing → bank reconciliation
matrix.exceptions: Stale or cancelled checks; payment holds

matrix.data_fields: Broker / agent; rate; base (net TCP); tranche %; release condition; EWT; non-cash incentives; clawback rule
matrix.handoff: Sales → commission computation → broker bill → AP (16); non-cash incentives via Purchase / Inventory
matrix.exceptions: Clawback on cancellation; split deals; commission on discounted price; manager overrides

matrix.data_fields: Homeowner; unit; dues rate; start date; billing cycle; utilities
matrix.handoff: Subscription / recurring invoices → collection → HOA fund accounting
matrix.exceptions: Dues arrears blocking services; developer-paid dues on unsold units

matrix.data_fields: Ticket; category; unit; SLA; warranty flag; cost; vendor
matrix.handoff: Helpdesk / Field Service → Purchase → AP (property-management expenses)
matrix.exceptions: Warranty vs chargeable; emergency repairs

matrix.data_fields: HOA registration; fund balance; assets; documents
matrix.handoff: Final PM accounting close → Documents
matrix.exceptions: Disputes on fund balance or common areas

matrix.trigger_event: Full payment, or lender requires title for release
matrix.data_fields: DOAS date; eCAR no.; new TCT / CCT no.; tax declaration; release date; recipient (buyer or lender)
matrix.handoff: Title tracker → Documents → buyer notice; feeds takeout release (13.1)
matrix.exceptions: Mother title not yet subdivided; lost documents; unpaid real-property tax

matrix.data_fields: Sales forecast; collection forecast; cost-to-complete; cash forecast
matrix.handoff: All modules → Spreadsheet / dashboards
matrix.exceptions: Unapproved reservations inflating pipeline; stale construction progress

matrix.data_fields: Budget vs actual by analytic account; absorption and sales velocity; collection efficiency; aging / DSO; % completion; cost variance
matrix.handoff: Accounting budget report → dashboards / BI
matrix.exceptions: Timing differences (commitments vs actuals); reclassifications after close

open_items.title: TORC scope
open_items.detail: TORC = taxes and other related charges. List each tax and charge PHI books under it, who shoulders each (buyer vs developer), and whether it is advanced and recharged or billed upfront.

open_items.title: Process numbering
open_items.detail: Confirm the proposed numbers for 01–03, 05–13 and 17 so every BRD chapter uses one ID set.

open_items.title: Turnover eligibility
open_items.detail: Which payment status allows turnover (equity paid, loan approved, fully paid) and who can approve exceptions?

open_items.title: Revenue recognition
open_items.detail: Agree the PFRS 15 method, collectability threshold and POC source with the external auditor before the Accounting design.

open_items.title: Commission release rules
open_items.detail: Tranches, clawback on cancellation, and treatment of in-house vs external brokers.

open_items.title: Invoicing compliance
open_items.detail: Current BIR CAS permit status and e-invoicing timeline — decides whether Odoo prints the official invoice series from go-live.

open_items.title: Lot as master model (vendor proposal)
open_items.detail: Confirm whether "Lot" is a custom real-estate model or Odoo's serial/lot record (stock.lot), and how it represents condo units, parking slots, house-and-lot packages, and merged or split lots.

open_items.title: Lot status design
open_items.detail: Separate construction status and sales status fields on the Lot, and who may change each (Construction, Sales admin, Credit & collection, Titling).

open_items.title: Migration from In4 Velocity
open_items.detail: How much buyer-ledger history moves (open balances only, or full payment history needed for Maceda computations)?

open_items.title: Approval matrix (DOA)
open_items.detail: Amount thresholds per document type, per company and per project to configure in Approvals.

diagrams.title: Plan-to-budget
diagrams.description: Annual cycle that produces both the corporate budget and life-of-project budgets, and hands a locked baseline to Accounting so every PR, PO and bill is checked against it.

diagrams.title: Land-to-inventory
diagrams.covers: 04 Land acquisition · 05 Project setup · 07 Inventory setup
diagrams.description: From a land opportunity to sellable lots: due diligence, agreement, milestone payments, title transfer, project creation, permits and License to Sell, then lot master and price-list creation.

diagrams.title: Reserve-to-contract
diagrams.description: A buyer picks a unit through an in-house or accredited broker; the reservation is receipted, documents and credit are checked, then the CTS and payment schedule are issued and the unit is tagged sold.

diagrams.title: Collect-to-cancel
diagrams.description: Monthly billing and collection with an event-based gateway: either payment arrives, or the due date plus grace lapses and delinquency handling begins, ending in reinstatement or a Maceda-compliant cancellation that returns the unit to inventory.

diagrams.title: Equity-to-takeout
diagrams.description: Once equity is fully paid the account splits by financing scheme: external loan takeout with lender approval, title annotation and release of proceeds, or in-house financing with an interest-bearing amortization schedule.

diagrams.title: Procure-to-pay
diagrams.covers: 03 Corporate expenses · 06 Project expenses · 14 TORC (taxes and other related charges) · 16 AP · 17 Commissions
diagrams.description: One pattern for every spend stream in the reference flow — corporate, land, project, sales, TORC, property management and loan payments — so budget checks, approvals, withholding tax and 2307s behave the same everywhere.

diagrams.title: Turnover-to-title & community
diagrams.covers: 15 Unit preparation & delivery · 14 TORC · 19 Title delivery · 18 Property management
diagrams.description: A completed unit is inspected and turned over when the account is eligible; a parallel split then starts homeowner onboarding and the title-transfer track, which ends with the title delivered to the buyer or lender.
